name: rosier
description: Rosier, a hero knight in heavy black plate armour with gold trim and a gold sun sigil on the breastplate, a closed black great helm with glowing red eye slits and a tattered grey cloak, a black longsword held angled down in his RIGHT hand and a tall black kite shield with a gold sigil on his LEFT arm, riding a black warhorse with glowing red eyes, a gold-studded bridle and a ragged red caparison
hands: the black longsword stays in the rider's right hand on the screen-left side and the black kite shield on his left arm on the screen-right side
